name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including document roots, static content, security headers, Fail2ban, UFW rules, SSH hardening, and development self-signed certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis password authentication, logging, service enablement, and compatibility settings for the Redis runtime environment.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI application with Python prerequisites, a Git checkout, virtual environment and dependencies, PostgreSQL database and user setup, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
